def rmse(y_true, y_pred):
    return np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred))

def evaluate_model(model, X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y_va, X_te, y_te, name):
    pred_tr = model.predict(X_tr)
    pred_va = model.predict(X_va)
    pred_te = model.predict(X_te)
    return {
        'Model': name,
        'Train R2': r2_score(y_tr, pred_tr),
        'Val R2': r2_score(y_va, pred_va),
        'Test R2': r2_score(y_te, pred_te),
        'Train RMSE': rmse(y_tr, pred_tr),
        'Val RMSE': rmse(y_va, pred_va),
        'Test RMSE': rmse(y_te, pred_te),
        'Train MAE': mean_absolute_error(y_tr, pred_tr),
        'Val MAE': mean_absolute_error(y_va, pred_va),
        'Test MAE': mean_absolute_error(y_te, pred_te)
    }

lookback = 4   # must match the lookback used in feature engineering

def create_sequences(X, y, lookback):
    Xs, ys = [], []
    for i in range(len(X) - lookback):
        Xs.append(X[i:i+lookback])
        ys.append(y[i+lookback])
    return np.array(Xs), np.array(ys)

X_tr_seq, y_tr_seq = create_sequences(X_train.values, y_train.values, lookback)
X_val_seq, y_val_seq = create_sequences(X_val.values, y_val.values, lookback)
X_test_seq, y_test_seq = create_sequences(X_test.values, y_test.values, lookback)

lstm_model = Sequential([
    LSTM(64, activation='tanh', input_shape=(lookback, X_train.shape[1])),
    Dropout(0.2),
    Dense(1)
])
lstm_model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='mse')
early_stop = EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=5, restore_best_weights=True)
history_lstm = lstm_model.fit(
    X_tr_seq, y_tr_seq,
    validation_data=(X_val_seq, y_val_seq),
    epochs=50, batch_size=32, callbacks=[early_stop], verbose=0
)

# Predictions
pred_tr_lstm = lstm_model.predict(X_tr_seq, verbose=0).flatten()
pred_val_lstm = lstm_model.predict(X_val_seq, verbose=0).flatten()
pred_test_lstm = lstm_model.predict(X_test_seq, verbose=0).flatten()

lstm_results = {
    'Model': 'LSTM',
    'Train R2': r2_score(y_tr_seq, pred_tr_lstm),
    'Val R2': r2_score(y_val_seq, pred_val_lstm),
    'Test R2': r2_score(y_test_seq, pred_test_lstm),
    'Train RMSE': rmse(y_tr_seq, pred_tr_lstm),
    'Val RMSE': rmse(y_val_seq, pred_val_lstm),
    'Test RMSE': rmse(y_test_seq, pred_test_lstm),
    'Train MAE': mean_absolute_error(y_tr_seq, pred_tr_lstm),
    'Val MAE': mean_absolute_error(y_val_seq, pred_val_lstm),
    'Test MAE': mean_absolute_error(y_test_seq, pred_test_lstm)
}

def plot_model_diagnostics(name, preds, actual_full, actual_test, history=None):
    """
    Creates a 2x3 grid of plots:
    1. Full dataset time series
    2. Test set time series
    3. Scatter plot (test) with 45° line
    4. Residual plot (test)
    5. Residual histogram
    6. Learning curve (if history provided, otherwise placeholder)
    """
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 10))
    fig.suptitle(f'{name} – Diagnostic Plots', fontsize=16)

    # 1. Full dataset time series
    ax = axes[0, 0]
    time_full = np.arange(len(actual_full))
    ax.plot(time_full, actual_full, label='Actual', alpha=0.7)
    ax.plot(time_full, preds['full'], label='Predicted', alpha=0.7)
    ax.set_title('Actual vs Predicted (Full Dataset)')
    ax.set_xlabel('Time (sequential)')
    ax.set_ylabel('Price')
    ax.legend()

    # 2. Test set time series
    ax = axes[0, 1]
    time_test = np.arange(len(actual_test))
    ax.plot(time_test, actual_test, label='Actual', alpha=0.7)
    ax.plot(time_test, preds['test'], label='Predicted', alpha=0.7)
    ax.set_title('Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)')
    ax.set_xlabel('Time (test order)')
    ax.set_ylabel('Price')
    ax.legend()

    # 3. Scatter plot (test)
    ax = axes[0, 2]
    ax.scatter(actual_test, preds['test'], alpha=0.5, s=10)
    min_val = min(actual_test.min(), preds['test'].min())
    max_val = max(actual_test.max(), preds['test'].max())
    ax.plot([min_val, max_val], [min_val, max_val], 'r--', label='Ideal')
    ax.set_xlabel('Actual Price')
    ax.set_ylabel('Predicted Price')
    ax.set_title('Test Set: Actual vs Predicted (Scatter)')
    ax.legend()
    ax.axis('equal')

    # 4. Residual plot (test)
    ax = axes[1, 0]
    residuals = actual_test - preds['test']
    ax.scatter(preds['test'], residuals, alpha=0.5, s=10)
    ax.axhline(y=0, color='r', linestyle='--')
    ax.set_xlabel('Predicted Price')
    ax.set_ylabel('Residual')
    ax.set_title('Residual Plot (Test)')

    # 5. Residual histogram
    ax = axes[1, 1]
    ax.hist(residuals, bins=30, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
    ax.axvline(x=0, color='r', linestyle='--')
    ax.set_xlabel('Residual')
    ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
    ax.set_title('Histogram of Residuals (Test)')

    # 6. Learning curve (if history exists)
    ax = axes[1, 2]
    if history is not None:
        if name == 'XGBoost':
            # XGBoost history: {'validation_0': {'rmse': [...]}}
            epochs = len(history['validation_0']['rmse'])
            ax.plot(range(epochs), history['validation_0']['rmse'], label='Validation RMSE')
            ax.set_xlabel('Boosting round')
            ax.set_ylabel('RMSE')
            ax.set_title('XGBoost Learning Curve')
            ax.legend()
        elif name == 'LightGBM':
            # LightGBM history: {'valid_0': {'rmse': [...]}}
            epochs = len(history['valid_0']['rmse'])
            ax.plot(range(epochs), history['valid_0']['rmse'], label='Validation RMSE')
            ax.set_xlabel('Boosting round')
            ax.set_ylabel('RMSE')
            ax.set_title('LightGBM Learning Curve')
            ax.legend()
        elif name == 'CatBoost':
            # CatBoost history: {'learn': {'RMSE': [...]}, 'validation': {'RMSE': [...]}}
            epochs = len(history['learn']['RMSE'])
            ax.plot(range(epochs), history['learn']['RMSE'], label='Train RMSE')
            ax.plot(range(epochs), history['validation']['RMSE'], label='Validation RMSE')
            ax.set_xlabel('Iteration')
            ax.set_ylabel('RMSE')
            ax.set_title('CatBoost Learning Curve')
            ax.legend()
        elif name == 'LSTM':
            # Keras history object has .history dict
            ax.plot(history.history['loss'], label='Train Loss')
            ax.plot(history.history['val_loss'], label='Val Loss')
            ax.set_xlabel('Epoch')
            ax.set_ylabel('MSE')
            ax.set_title('LSTM Loss Curve')
            ax.legend()
        else:
            ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'Learning curve not available\nfor this model', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
    else:
        if name in ['Ridge', 'Lasso', 'RandomForest', 'LightGBM_linear', 'MLP', 'LightGBM_quantile']:
            ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'Learning curve not applicable\n(not iterative)', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)
        else:
            ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'No history recorded', ha='center', va='center', transform=ax.transAxes)

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

# Overfitting judgment for baseline models
def judge(row):
    gap = row['Train R2'] - row['Test R2']
    if row['Test R2'] < 0:
        return "Test R2 negative – severe concept drift"
    if gap < 0.1:
        return "Excellent – very low overfitting"
    elif gap < 0.2:
        return "Good – mild overfitting"
    elif gap < 0.3:
        return "Moderate overfitting – acceptable"
    else:
        return "Severe overfitting – needs more regularisation"

baseline_results['Train-Test R2 Gap'] = baseline_results['Train R2'] - baseline_results['Test R2']
baseline_results['Judgment'] = baseline_results.apply(judge, axis=1)
baseline_results[['Model', 'Train R2', 'Test R2', 'Train-Test R2 Gap', 'Judgment']]
